inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single continuous ten-second cinematic LIVE-ACTION shot of Scorpion using HIS CHAIN SPEAR to catch and pull Sub-Zero. EXACTLY the same two adult human actors, human faces and proportions, wet practical costumes and sunlit ruined courtyard as Picture1. Masked Scorpion in yellow and black LEFT; masked Sub-Zero in blue and black RIGHT. Preserve both black hoods, masks, boots, cloth, frost on blue forearms, and existing water/frost patches on stone. Serious urgent intent, fast physical execution at normal speed.

Continue the actual recovery from Picture1: Scorpion's raised knee drops and his boot plants immediately. He springs backward TWO short steps to open a visible gap while Sub-Zero advances a guarded half-step. Scorpion's hand flame dissipates before he reaches his waist. With his RIGHT hand he unsnaps ONE compact triangular steel kunai from his own belt; his LEFT hand controls the coil of thin linked METAL CHAIN attached to its handle. This is one short spearhead and one chain, not a sword or several weapons.

Scorpion plants his forward LEFT boot, draws his right elbow back and rotates his shoulders. He snaps his RIGHT arm forward, releasing the kunai straight toward the center of Sub-Zero's BLUE UPPER CHEST. The spearhead visibly CROSSES THE EXISTING GAP before reaching the blue vest. A SINGLE connected chain feeds from Scorpion's controlling hand/belt behind that travelling spearhead. The tip catches into the front cloth at upper chest level; show a sharp costume jolt without a wound close-up or blood. Sub-Zero's chest and shoulders recoil only AFTER that contact. The chain's brief curve then pulls into a taut line between the caught tip and Scorpion's hands. Exactly one tether stays connected at both ends throughout.

Scorpion immediately catches the line with both hands, sinks his hips and braces a rear boot. He drives his elbows back toward his waist in ONE powerful hauling pull. TENSION IN THE CHAIN visibly reaches the blue chest first; then Sub-Zero's torso pitches toward Scorpion and his boots stumble through two or three fast catching steps across the stones. He tries to brake with a planted heel and reaches toward the tether, but the pull forces him close. He does not choose to walk in, teleport or float. Scorpion's planted body and hauling hands remain the source of the pull; the blue fighter is the person being moved.

As Sub-Zero arrives WITHIN ARM'S REACH, Scorpion arrests the pull by shifting his weight into the front boot. The blue fighter absorbs the stop in bent knees and remains upright but pitched forward and momentarily off-balance. Scorpion transfers control of the line to his LEFT hand held low near his own waist. His RIGHT fist is free and drawn near his lower ribs, ready for the next shot, but he does NOT punch yet. The short remaining chain sags slightly between his left hand and the single spearhead still caught in the blue vest; extra links hang by Scorpion's belt. End while the blue catching step settles and the yellow right fist readies. No uppercut, skull reveal or fire finisher in this shot.

CAMERA starts at the exact viewpoint of Picture1, then dollies back enough to show the newly opened gap and the COMPLETE connected chain. A small lateral glide gives a clear three-quarter view of spear travel and the blue catching steps. Keep yellow LEFT, blue RIGHT, both bodies and support boots visible; do not orbit across the tether, cut at contact, hide a missing trajectory with flash, or use artificial shake. Columns, stairs and doorway remain coherent. Metallic chain glints and its weight follow arm motion and gravity; it never grows from Sub-Zero, splits, vanishes or becomes a light beam. Preserve photographic skin and cloth. No new sword, scabbard, third person, masks removed, fresh frozen shell, slow motion or text.

overall_soundscape: Short recovery footfalls, metal kunai release, quick chain rattle through the gap, one compact cloth/impact sound at the catch, a sharp taut-chain clink, braced boots and urgent dragged/catching steps, loose-link clatter as tension eases, quiet courtyard wind. No speech, grunts, music or laughter.

non_diegetic_music: None.

_meta.title: T05 — one chain spear, visible catch, tension and forced pull
